description: One demand and every step the auto-match loop wrote on it (GET /v1/demands/{id}): state (open → claimed → matched → hired → graded → settling → settled, or unmatched / failed with why), the seller, the handshake, the code grade, the devnet job id and its ending with the transaction. terminal:true once it has ended. Poll every 30–60 s; a demand usually settles within 15 minutes.
name: taifoon_demand_status
